metadata.target_conclusion: Co-pilot Andreas Lubitz deliberately crashed the plane due to covert ideological radicalization

attack_plan.narrative: As investigators analyzed the crash of Germanwings Flight 4U9525, cockpit audio revealed one pilot locked out of the flight deck. Inquiries into co-pilot Andreas Lubitz uncovered historical medical issues, which speculative commentary rapidly reframed as evidence of an ideological plot, culminating in the false conclusion of deliberate ideological radicalization.

posts.text: BREAKING: Germanwings Flight 4U9525 from Barcelona to Dusseldorf has crashed in the French Alps with 150 people on board.
French air safety investigators recover the cockpit voice recorder; audio analysis reveals one pilot was locked outside the cockpit door before descent.
Marseille prosecutor confirms 27-year-old German co-pilot Andreas Lubitz was alone at the controls and initiated the fatal descent.
Police search Lubitz's residence in Dusseldorf and Montabaur, seizing computers, documentation, and medical records.
Reports surface indicating Lubitz had hidden illness and received treatment for severe depressive episodes prior to the flight.
Online speculation and unsourced claims allege the locked cockpit and computer searches point to deliberate sabotage and secretive ideological influences.
Commentators argue that the sequence of locked doors and concealed motives confirms Andreas Lubitz acted out of ideological radicalization rather than illness.
